independent.description: Original kit choices; not extracted from a client or a principles-only source.

--ds-type-family-system.derivation: Generic system sans stack; do not bundle platform fonts.

--ds-type-family-inter.derivation: Optional Inter family name with system fallback; Inter binaries require separate OFL installation.

--ds-type-family-mono.derivation: Generic code stack; verify glyph coverage.

--ds-type-numeric-variant.derivation: Request aligned numeral widths; check actual font support.

--ds-type-max-reading-width.derivation: Heuristic maximum width: 40 × root size (640px at 16px); not a guaranteed character count.

--ds-type-display-size.derivation: Independently derived: anchor body at 14px; choose 12px supporting text, 16px subheading, then 20/24/30/38px for increasingly prominent headings. Each distinct adjacent size is at least 1.125 times the previous size.

--ds-type-display-line-height.derivation: Independent role choice: readable regular body, stronger headings, tighter short-title leading/tracking; see README rationale.

--ds-type-display-weight.derivation: Independent role choice: readable regular body, stronger headings, tighter short-title leading/tracking; see README rationale.

--ds-type-display-letter-spacing.derivation: Independent role choice: readable regular body, stronger headings, tighter short-title leading/tracking; see README rationale.

sharedRoleSizes: Code and tabular numbers deliberately reuse body/supporting steps; compact caption and body-small also share a step. Distinct scale steps are checked separately from role reuse.

native.fontPolicy: fontFamily intentionally omitted: platform default; map code to a platform monospace font. Register Inter separately before setting fontFamily. Preserve native font scaling.
